items.ig_caption:
10 ways your AI agent gets turned on you. 🤖

The OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications, one line each:
→ ASI01 Goal hijack: hidden instructions change what the agent is trying to do
→ ASI02 Tool misuse: connected tools used in ways nobody intended
→ ASI03 Privilege abuse: credentials and permissions wider than the task
→ ASI04 Supply chain: a malicious tool, plugin or MCP server feeds it bad instructions
→ ASI05 Unexpected code execution: generated code runs where it shouldn't
→ ASI06 Memory poisoning: corrupted context makes it act on false premises
→ ASI07 Insecure agent-to-agent messages: no authentication or integrity checks
→ ASI08 Cascading failures: one bad agent spreads the damage downstream
→ ASI09 Human trust exploitation: convincing output gets people to approve the wrong thing
→ ASI10 Rogue agents: an agent keeps acting, and keeps its access, after it should stop

Start here: an inventory of every agent and what it can touch, an allowlist of MCP servers, and human review for high-impact actions.
